entries.claim: 200 mg caffeine is about two 8-oz cups of coffee
entries.source: FDA consumer update 'Spilling the Beans: How Much Caffeine is Too Much?' (earlier version: an 8-ounce cup of coffee is about 80-100 mg; current version: 400 mg is about two to three 12-oz cups), https://www.fda.gov/consumers/consumer-updates/spilling-beans-how-much-caffeine-too-much . USDA cites ~95 mg per 8 oz brewed. 2 x 80-100 mg = 160-200 mg.
